title: 第2041章 你虽然是牛但也不能张口就吹第2040章 还要自己回来
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
第2041章你虽然是牛，但也不能张口就吹！
火刀笑了。
原本它还想将阴虚直接弄回来，谁知阴虚竟要主动回来！
而且还带着一群灰尘之地生物！
这还买一送一？
它真是笑了。
时间不长——
天地突然变色，虚空疯狂扭曲，各种恐怖黑洞出现在天穹之上，如同天破了一般。
一股又一股可怕的气息，从黑洞中疯狂荡漾而出，刹那便席卷住了整方倒悬星空。
所有生灵都倍感压抑，有种天塌了的感觉。
他们都很清楚，这是有极其恐怖的强者要降临过来了！
“不属于我们这片星空的气息，这是其上星空强者要降临过来了吗！？”
“这种气息太恐怖了，我感觉仅是这样的气息激荡，便能摧毁掉我们整片星空！”
他们满脸的惊悚与恐慌，第一时间就想逃离。
但他们的身体却完全不听使唤，根本动不了一点！
‘唰唰唰’——
炽芒激射，一道又一道可怕的身影，从黑洞中陆续走出。
走在最前方的正是早前跑路的阴虚。
它立于高空之上，眼神睥睨，浑身上下洋溢着绝对的自信。
同它而来的灰尘之地生物，实力全都强大无比，且还掌握有绝对的底牌和手段，镇杀掉陈长生等，一点问题都没有！

“我超威，你王者归来啊，搞这么大的阵仗！”
孟浪说道。
他一点担忧与害怕都没有，底气十足，言语间尽是调侃。
“回来了哈。”
火刀横空，同阴虚等对峙。
“死到临头还不知！”
阴虚神色冷漠，眼神如同看死人般的从火刀和陈长生等身上一一扫过。
“有点意思啊，你们在应对即将到来的大战时，还能抽出力量对内进行清除吗？”
野刻看着火刀和陈长生等，缓缓说道：“不过你们又能抽出多少的力量呢？”
这也是他敢来此，且自信无比，连气息都不遮掩的原因。
如他所说——
即将到来的大战才是最致命的，这边现世必定都在集合力量应对将要到来的大战。
纵然这边现世想对内进行清除，能抽出的力量也注定有限，不会强到哪里去。
尤其最重要的是——
来倒悬星空进行清理的力量，又能有多强呢？
注定强的有限！
毕竟若是足够恐怖强大的话，也不会进倒悬星空这边清理，只会前往那些更强大的星空内进行清理。
“没多强，不过对付你们足够了。”
火刀笑了一声。
“行，那就看看你们有多强。”

野刻神色淡然，轻轻地挥了一下手，道：“去看看他们有多强。”
随着他声音落地，有一头灰尘之地生物走了出来。
这是一头形似蛮牛的灰尘之地生物，其体型庞大如山，浑身上下如若金属铸成般，极具压迫感。
它肆无忌惮的释放自身气息，没有丝毫的收敛。
如今形势已然同往日大不相同。
content_en:
Chapter 2041 Although you are a cow, you can’t just brag!
Fire Knife smiled.
Originally, he wanted to bring Yinxu back directly, but who knew that Yinxu would come back on his own initiative!
And he also brought a group of dust land creatures with him!
Is this buy one get one free?
It really laughed.
Not long——
The color of the sky and the earth suddenly changed, the void twisted crazily, and various terrifying black holes appeared in the sky, as if the sky was broken.
One after another, terrifying aura rippled wildly out of the black hole, sweeping across the entire starry sky in an instant.
All living beings feel depressed and feel like the sky is falling.
They all knew that an extremely terrifying powerful man was coming!
"The aura that does not belong to our starry sky, is this the starry sky powerhouse coming from above!?"
"This aura is so terrifying. I feel like just this aura can destroy our entire starry sky!"
Their faces were full of horror and panic, and they wanted to escape immediately.
But their bodies were completely out of control and couldn't move at all!
‘Swish, swish, swish’——
Blazing light shot out, and terrifying figures one after another walked out of the black hole.
The person walking at the front was Yinxu who had run away earlier.
It stands high in the sky, its eyes are stern, and its whole body is filled with absolute confidence.
The creatures from the dust land that came with it are all extremely powerful, and they also have absolute trump cards and methods. They can kill Chen Changsheng and others without any problems!
"I am Chaowei, you are back as the king, and you are going to have such a big battle!"
Meng Lang said.
He was not worried or afraid at all, he was confident, and his words were full of ridicule.
"He's back."
The fire knife flies across the sky, confronting Yinxu and others.
“I don’t know when I’m going to die!”
Yinxu looked indifferent, and his eyes swept over Huo Dao, Chen Changsheng and others one by one as if he were looking at dead people.
"It's interesting. When dealing with the upcoming war, can you still find the strength to clean up the interior?"
Ye Ke looked at Huo Dao, Chen Changsheng and others, and said slowly: "But how much power can you draw out?"
This is why he dared to come here and was so confident that he didn't even hide his breath.
As he said——
The coming war is the most deadly, and everyone in this world must be gathering strength to deal with the coming war.
Even if this world wants to clean up the inside, the power it can extract is bound to be limited and it won't be much stronger.
Especially the most important thing is——
How strong can the power that comes to clean up the starry sky be?
Destined to be very strong!
After all, if it is terrifying and powerful enough, it will not go to the upside-down starry sky to clean up, but will only go to those more powerful starry skies to clean up.
"It's not that strong, but it's enough to deal with you."
Fire Knife laughed.
"Okay, let's see how strong you are."
Ye Ke looked indifferent, waved his hand gently and said, "Go and see how strong they are."
As his voice fell, a creature from the land of dust came out.
This is a creature from the dust that looks like a wild bull. It is as big as a mountain, and its whole body looks like it is made of metal. It is extremely oppressive.
It released its own aura unscrupulously, without any restraint.
The situation today is very different from the past.
